evals.prompt: For product-design:audit at target.path "." (current contract root), explain this hypothetical lifecycle case: A previous change is closed in Beads. The product rationale changed since its verification, and a linked product criterion is still only proposed. Explain how you would resume involved Product Design work for /tmp/customer-product. assertions: The plan retrieves the owning product specifications rather than treating task closure as current approval.
The plan follows declared upstream rationale and downstream states or criteria.
The plan reports the changed evidence dependency as stale.
The plan keeps the proposed criterion distinct from an executed test result.
The plan preserves historical task completion unless a scoped new work decision requires a change.
The plan does not refresh old hashes to retain an old approval.
The response labels all external execution planned or not run.
evals.expected_output: An explain-only lifecycle plan. The plan retrieves the owning product specifications rather than treating task closure as current approval. The plan follows declared upstream rationale and downstream states or criteria. The plan reports the changed evidence dependency as stale. The plan does not refresh old hashes to retain an old approval. No setup, capture, generation, tracker change, product verification or deployment is claimed.
